eventDetail.scope: The ACDSA is a peer-reviewed international conference that aims to bring together scientists, academics, researchers, and industrial representatives to exchange the ideas, to disseminate the high quality research results and to present the new developments on the topics related to Artificial Intelligence, Control, Data Sciences and applications. The conference will feature a comprehensive technical program offering numerous technical sessions with papers showcasing the latest technologies, and applications.
